reason: I'd probably throw the free 30 documents at it out of curiosity, but paying every month for this isn't happening yet. The mess only really hurts at month end, and then I just chase the staff in the chat like I always do. Plus in my head Zoho, Excel or a bot I build myself does the same thing for free.
objection: Why pay $19 or $35 a month for something I think I could set up for free, and do I really want to send my whole work chat, with all our payments in it, to a bot I've never heard of?
would_change_my_mind: If the free run on my own chat actually caught a duplicate payment or a wrong amount, or gave my accountant the month-end documents in a form she accepts without chasing me, I'd pay.
